defects.quote: Because no policy is configured, the verdict is NO_POLICY
defects.why: NO_POLICY proves only that no applicable rule was evaluated, not that no policy was configured.

defects.quote: No SLO/threshold policy appears to be configured
defects.why: The evidence cannot establish whether policies exist but are inapplicable versus are absent.

defects.quote: no data before/after the window is present
defects.why: The evidence includes whole-run metrics and states that the run extends 230 ms beyond the evaluation window.

notes: The verdict and measurements are reported accurately, but it overstates the cause of NO_POLICY.

defects.quote: no resource or business policy existed
defects.why: NO_POLICY establishes no applicable evaluated rule, not that no policies existed.

defects.quote: the 'target' series appears to represent a configured/synthetic load level or a different signal rather than the measured achieved throughput
defects.why: A resource-series mean and a transaction-throughput aggregate have no defined direct equivalence, so their differing values cannot establish this relationship.
The evidence does not distinguish absent policies from configured but inapplicable policies.
NO_POLICY does not identify the absence of a threshold as its established cause.

notes: It preserves the principal measurements and useful checks but makes unsupported claims about policy configuration and metric equivalence.

defects.quote: a flat series cannot support a calibrated correlation estimate
defects.why: The reported value resource series is not flat: it has min 3, max 21, mean 12, and a positive slope; the evidence reports absent residual variation, not absent raw variation.

notes: This is otherwise a well-scoped and evidence-based response, with one misleading characterization of the resource series.

defects.quote: Metric summaries (overall and for the 'request' transaction) report ... over 700 samples in the evaluation window
defects.why: The overall and transaction metric summaries are whole-run scopes, not evaluation-window summaries, even though a separate window summary has matching counts.

defects.quote: With a flat p95 latency series ... and non-varying resource values
defects.why: The evidence provides only aggregate latency percentiles and reports resource values varying from 3 to 21, so neither asserted time-series behavior is supported.

notes: The core verdict guidance is sound, but it misstates metric scope and invents unsupported series behavior.
